propositions: Author-facing guides currently describe Success Criteria as a distinct container-level requirement, but this distinction is being removed across the codebase as part of epic 1386 vocabulary collapse.

The guides at lines 58-76 of writing-a-passing-plan.md and sections 219-230 of user-guide.md must be rewritten to remove SC vocabulary and re-express container guidance as a decomposition/coverage requirement (G3/G4/G5) rather than a separate heading.

The rewritten container section must retain guidance that distinguishes containers from leaves (child decomposition covering acceptance criteria, testing deferred to children) so it remains informative rather than vacuous.
After rewrite, grep for 'success[ _-]criteri(a|on)' must return no matches in the guide files, and rebar explain plan must render with no SC vocabulary.
